'''Bruhn''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. At some point<ref name="Fallen Jedi" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he began to succumb to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. In order to protect the Jedi Order from the effects of such transformation, Bruhn decided to sacrifice himself for the organization's benefit. The fallen Jedi [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] himself in a [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] on a [[Unidentified fringe planet|planet]] situated at [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] fringe and eventually [[Death/Legends|died]] there.<ref name="Fallen Jedi" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&ndash;allied individual sought out Bruhn's tomb, eventually discovering the Jedi's body and returning it to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]],<ref name="Fallen Jedi" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Jedi Order.<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> However, the individual who found Bruhn kept his belongings.<ref name="Fallen Jedi" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bruhn was introduced in a Treasure Hunting Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Fallen Jedi" />
